# secopsctl ingest

Data ingestion: feeds, forwarders, parsers, log types, pipeline, health

## ingest feeds delete

MUTATING (guarded): delete a feed by id (stops its ingestion)

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl ingest feeds delete <id> [flags]
```

```text
Delete a single ingestion feed by id — the feed UUID, or its full resource
name. Deleting a feed STOPS its ingestion, so feeds are deliberately not
prune-eligible via `push feeds`; this is the explicit, one-off path.
Guarded: dry-run by default, --yes to apply.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## ingest feeds get

Read-only: get one feed by id (full config + state)

```text

```

## ingest feeds list

Read-only: list live feeds with state (and failure message if failed)

```text

```

```text
List the instance's feeds with their runtime state — a quick imperative read
of what is ingesting and what has failed (the config-as-code snapshot is
`pull feeds`). JSON or table.
```

## ingest log-types create

Create a custom log type (permanent — no API delete)

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl ingest log-types create <log-type-id> <display-name> [flags]
```

```text
Create a custom log type with the given ID and display name.

The ID is uppercased with a _CUSTOM suffix appended automatically.
The display name gets a ' Custom' suffix.

WARNING: custom log types cannot be deleted or renamed — the API
has no delete or patch endpoint, and the console offers neither.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply the change |

## ingest log-types get

Show the description of one log type

```text
secopsctl ingest log-types get <log-type>
```

## ingest log-types list

List log types, by default only those with active feeds

```text
secopsctl ingest log-types list [--search <pattern>] [flags]
```

```text
List the instance's log types. By default shows only log types with
feedCount > 0 (actively ingesting). Use --all for the full catalog.

Sort with --sort: name (default), feeds, collection.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | bool | false | show all log types, including those with no feeds |
| `--limit` | int | 5000 | max log types to scan |
| `--search` | string | - | case-insensitive substring filter on id/display name |
| `--sort` | string | name | sort by: name, feeds, collection |

## ingest parsers extension extract

Discover extractable fields, or create an extractor extension

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl ingest parsers extension extract <log-type> [flags]
```

```text
Without --fields or --all: read-only discovery of raw-log fields that
can be extracted to UDM (equivalent to the console's Extract Additional
Fields panel).

With --fields f1,f2 or --all: create a parser extension (extractor type)
that maps the selected fields. Guarded; pass --yes to apply.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | bool | false | extract all discovered fields |
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--fields` | string | - | comma-separated field names to extract |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply the change |

## ingest parsers extension setting

Show or update the auto-extraction setting for a log type

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl ingest parsers extension setting <log-type> [opt-in|all|disabled] [flags]
```

```text
Without a second argument, shows the current extraction setting (OPT_IN,
ALL_FIELDS, or DISABLED). With a setting, updates it (guarded).

  opt-in    extract only explicitly selected fields
  all       extract all fields (up to 100)
  disabled  turn off auto-extraction
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply the change |

## ingest parsers rollback

Revert a parser to its previous version (opt out of preview / rollback)

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl ingest parsers rollback <log-type> [flags]
```

```text
Deactivate the active release-candidate parser for a log type, reverting to
the previous stable version. Equivalent to the web console's
"Opt out of Preview" / "Rollback to Last Used Version".

The parser must have an active RELEASE_CANDIDATE (from a prior upgrade).
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply the rollback |

## ingest parsers run

Validate a CBN parser against sample logs (no server change)

```text
secopsctl ingest parsers run <log-type> --cbn <file> --logs <file> [flags]
```

```text
Run a parser's CBN against sample log lines and print the parsed UDM.
Purely inert — it creates and activates nothing — so it's safe to run before
`push parsers` (which would create a new version and activate it).

Per-log errors (UDM validation failures, field-type mismatches) are surfaced in
table mode as a one-line error per failed log; --json includes the full error
detail per result.

When a log produces no output, the statedump diagnostic (@onErrorCount and
intermediate state) is shown automatically. Use --statedump to see the full
statedump for every log (including successful ones).
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--cbn` | string | - | parser source (CBN) file to test (required) |
| `--logs` | string | - | sample log lines, one per line ('-' for stdin) (required) |
| `--statedump` | bool | false | show full statedump for every log (debugging) |

## ingest parsers sample-logs

Fetch a sample of RAW logs for a log type (to develop/validate a parser)

```text
secopsctl ingest parsers sample-logs <log-type> [flags]
```

```text
List a sample of a log type's raw (ingested) logs directly (logTypes/<type>/logs)
and print each one's FULL raw bytes, one per line — the sample to develop or
validate a parser against. Pipe into a parser test:

  secopsctl parsers sample-logs KONG_GATEWAY --limit 50 | \
    secopsctl parsers run KONG_GATEWAY --cbn parser.conf --logs -

The simplest raw-log path — a direct list, no search (cf. `query udm --raw` /
`query raw`, which scope by UDM metadata / content). NOTE: logs are ordered by
resource name, not time, so this is a sample — pass --since to bound by time.
--json emits structured records (use it for logs with embedded newlines).
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | int | 100 | max sample logs to fetch |
| `--since` | duration | 0s | only logs collected within this window (e.g. 2h); default: most recent |

## ingest parsers upgrade

Preview and activate a prebuilt parser update (release candidate)

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl ingest parsers upgrade <log-type> [flags]
```

```text
Check whether a newer version of a prebuilt parser is available, show a diff
of current vs candidate CBN source, and activate the release candidate.

Equivalent to the web console's "Opt in to Preview" action. Dry-run by default;
pass --yes to activate the candidate.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | activate the release candidate |

## ingest parsers validate

Show parsing errors from a submitted parser's validation report (why a submit failed)

```text
secopsctl ingest parsers validate <log-type> [flags]
```

```text
After `push parsers` / `parsers activate` fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION (a
validation failure with no detail), this surfaces WHY: the most recently
submitted parser's validation report and its parsing errors — the per-log error
message plus a preview of the failing raw log (--show-logs for the full sample).
Closes the parser-dev loop in-tool.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | int | 100 | max parsing errors to fetch |
| `--show-logs` | bool | false | print the full failing raw log per error (default: a 120-char preview) |
